summary: Reading a stinking-cloud scroll reaches read.c:seffect_stinking_cloud, but js/read.js:seffects records the effect as unported. The C wrapper prints discovery feedback and enters read.c:do_stinking_cloud, which prompts for a location, validates it, then calls region.c:create_gas_cloud. Port the whole prompt and cloud effect family so the recorded location and later cloud RNG are source ordered.

source.branch: seffect_stinking_cloud checks spellbook or known scroll status, prints discovery only when unknown, sets gk.known, and passes that status to do_stinking_cloud. The callee asks for the cloud center, configures getpos highlighting with can_center_cloud, handles cancellation and invalid coordinates, then calls create_gas_cloud with size and damage derived from bcsign of the object. The selected case reaches the prompt at step 28 and waits after cloud creation at step 34.
callers: read.c:seffects SCR_STINKING_CLOUD arm calls seffect_stinking_cloud after doread; js/read.js:seffects currently records note_unported(read.c seffect_stinking_cloud).
read.c:seffect_stinking_cloud calls do_stinking_cloud after identification feedback; its return is discarded.
dependencies: read.c:can_center_cloud and its getpos validity callback are already implemented in js/read.js; preserve the C prompt, highlight, cancellation, and invalid-location paths.
region.c:create_gas_cloud is implemented in js/region.js, but its return is discarded by read.c:do_stinking_cloud; wire its state, screen, and RNG effects through the production caller.
getpos.c:getpos is available in js/getpos.js. Check the scroll versus spell object class, bcsign, and Hallucination message branch from source.

evidence: Current saved challenges/evaluations/20260927175933-v9.json leaves 5 of 35 screens unmatched, first at segment 0 step 30. Its later C RNG call rn2(4)=1 comes from region.c:create_gas_cloud at step 34, after the missing prompt path.
